outgoing.name: Africa
outgoing.excerpt: The Aardvark (Orycteropus afer) is a medium-sized mammal native to Africa.

outgoing.name: Afrikaans
outgoing.excerpt: The name comes from the Afrikaans/Dutch for "earth pig" (aarde earth, varken pig), because early settlers from Europe thought it resembled a pig.

outgoing.name: Pliocene
